Sell signal from indicator buffer 0 (trend cycle crossing down through level 50 or color change to bearish)
Martingale lot size calculation after loss

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one (implied by no_opposite_side gate)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMRec (Martingale Recovery): base lot on win, multiplied lot on consecutive loss; LotMultiplier applied per loss, resets to base Lot on win

custom_logic_notes: Duplex pattern means EA operates on two correlated/inverse symbols simultaneously. CExpertMoney MMRec implements martingale recovery: after a losing trade, the next lot size is multiplied by LotMultiplier; after a winning trade, lot resets to base value. The custom indicator ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle is a Schaff Trend Cycle applied to JJRSX (Jurik RSX) - a double-smoothed momentum oscillator. Signal is trend cycle direction change or level crossover. SL/TP values use _Point with digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle must be reimplemented in Python (JJRSX + Schaff Trend Cycle). Martingale money management must be explicitly coded with state tracking of consecutive losses. Duplex (dual-symbol) operation requires parallel signal tracking on two symbols. Digit adjustment logic for SL/TP must handle both 4-digit and 5-digit broker conventions. The CExpertMoney/CExpertBase inheritance pattern from MT5 Expert library adds complexity - the order management and position tracking logic embedded in these base classes needs manual replication.
